twank: To cause to make a sharp twanging sound; to twang, or twangle. Addison.

twink: 1. A wink; a twinkling. (old) 2. (Zoöl.) The chaffinch. [Prov. Eng.]

twelfthcake: An ornamented cake distributed among friends or visitors on the festival of Twelfth-night.
twotoone: Designating, or pert. to, a gear for reducing or increasing a velocity ratio two to one.

twiggy: Of or pertaining to a twig or twigs; like a twig or twigs; full of twigs; abounding with shoots. " Twiggy trees." Evelyn.

twisting: a. & n. from Twist. Twisting pair. (Kinematics) See under Pair, n., 7.
